source_note: All priced sold rows in the saved May, July and October 2005 Savills catalogue grids that still lacked a street address were checked against the complete official HM Land Registry 2005 and 2006 Price Paid Data by exact sale price, stated locality and a 0-180 day post-auction window. Four matches were retained: three were unique exact-price/locality transactions and one had a second residential locality candidate but was discriminated by the saved Savills Retail class and an official gambling-premises record at the retained address. Each retained address also has independent official evidence of compatible commercial use. Ambiguous or property-class-conflicting matches were left unchanged. This enriches already banked appearances and does not assert catalogue completeness.
